PRODUCTS & SERVICES
AGRONOMY
We are focused on trusted service and dedicated to helping farmers make confident, informed decisions for their operations. We believe that innovation and stewardship go hand in hand – harnessing technology, agronomic insight, and local expertise to drive productivity while protecting the land we all depend on. Together we grow – guided by trust, fueled by innovation, and united by a shared commitment to progress across every acre we serve.
AGRONOMY >
PROPANE
There is no substitute for reliable energy. That’s why Linn Co-op provides dependable propane and fuel solutions for farms, homes and businesses across our communities. Our focus on safety, and hometown reliability means our customers can count on comfort and confidence all year long. Our team takes pride in delivery more than just energy – we deliver trusted service and peace of mind.
PROPANE >
GRAIN
We understand that every bushel represents hard work, dedication, and trust. Our Grain team is committed to helping farmers maximize the value of their crops through reliable service, competitive markets, and dependable expertise. From harvest to delivery, we provide the tools, technology, and support that make marketing decisions simpler and more successful.
GRAIN >
LAWN CARE
Our experienced team provides professional lawn care, tree care, and pest control services designed around your needs and schedule. We take pride in clear communication, dependable service, and results you can see season after season. We offer quality products – including fertilizer, weed control, seed, and erosion matting – along with expert advice to help you succeed.
LAWN CARE >
CAR CENTER & TIRE SERVICE
We keep you – and your equipment – moving with confidence. From routing maintenance and repairs to complete tire service, our skilled technicians deliver dependable care for cars, light trucks, and farm equipment alike. When the work can’t wait, our 24/7 on-farm tire service is ready to roll – bringing fast, reliable support straight to your operation so you can stay productive when it matters most.
CAR CENTER >
REFINED FUELS & DIESEL
We provide dependable refined fuels and premium diesel solutions designed to keep farms, fleets, and businesses running smoothly all year long. Our focus on safety, consistent quality, and professional service means customers can count on reliable delivery, dependable products, and on‑site expertise that supports the demands of modern equipment. Backed by local commitment and trusted service, our team delivers more than fuel—we deliver confidence and peace of mind with every gallon.
FUELS >
